title: A page item's mockup focus and fields are checked when it is written, not only when the page draws it
why: Incident (shiv, Nov 1 17:06 CST, photo of another repo's waiting page, item 51, speaker sheet volume fill, lane local_3808a094): the card showed "The picture of option A shows nothing the focus names" and "This item carries a field the page does not draw" to the owner. The page caught both, but only at render, on his screen.
note: Cause (read): hooks/question_form.py checks fields against main's itemFields list (rule item-field-rendered) but never checks a design's focus or state against its mockup, because the mockup lives in the page's designData, not the database. The skill's read-back (waiting-page, Add an item, step 2) asks the writer to check focus by hand; that step was skipped. A field warning means the item was written before the field guard, or the live page is older than main's list (stale_pages would say behind). Not the advisor: the advisor answers no question and checks no page write. Fix in one home: the design republish (Add a design, step 3) runs the page's own focus and state test on <out> before publish, and refuses a design whose focus or state finds nothing; same test code as the page, never a copy. Which repo's page and session wrote item 51 is unknown here: ask that page's writer to fix item 51. Red first on a mockup with a missing focus. Cloud lane, claude-settings only. Needs no answer. Placed after local-cc-version-lag (triage 5).
